facts.text: Serve the cucumbers when Granny pulls them out of the cold stream.
facts.why: No source shows Granny pulling cucumbers from a stream. The transcript has Granny telling the girls to keep pumping the well until the water gets cold.
facts.fix: Serve the cucumbers when Granny tells the girls to keep pumping till the water gets cold.

facts.text: Dad, can we take the corn to Mother? It will make her feel better.
facts.why: In the film Mei takes the corn on her own after an argument, gets lost, and the Catbus carries the sisters to the hospital where they leave the ear of corn on the windowsill. Satsuki never asks Dad.
facts.fix: The corn is for Mum. Eat yours, then we'll leave hers on the hospital windowsill.

fix_note.text: The corn is for Mum. Eat yours, then we'll leave hers on the hospital windowsill.

vibe.verdict: Gentle and close to the film, with the umbrella, Catbus and corn for Mum, but the stream and corn details need a closer match.
